# F3: HUD, markers and symbology {#sec-fg-hud-markers}

The engine draws map markers, location symbols and the marker picker from
four config classes. This page covers the schema AEE re-declares, the picker
collapse, the echelon overlay and the location draw-style enum.

## What works

- `CfgMarkers` holds one class per marker. The engine reads `icon` and
  `texture` for the drawn image, `color[]` for the tint, and `size` for the
  box. The class starts at line 84992 of the `Addons/ui_f.pbo` config.
  {src:pbo:Addons/ui_f.pbo:84992}
- A marker names its picker group with `markerClass`. {src:cfg:CfgMarkers.markerClass}
- `CfgMarkerClasses` declares the picker groups as one flat list. Vanilla
  ships Default, System, Military, Draw, the four NATO affiliation groups,
  NATO_Sizes, NATO_Respawn, Locations and Flags. The class starts at line
  86243. {src:pbo:Addons/ui_f.pbo:86243}
- `CfgMarkerColors` maps a colour name to one `color[]` RGBA value. AEE adds
  the class `ColorAEE`. {src:cfg:CfgMarkerColors.color[]}
- `CfgLocationTypes` holds one class per location type. The engine reads
  `icon`, `texture`, `color[]`, `size`, `textSize`, `font`, `shadow`,
  `importance` and `drawStyle`. The class starts at line 78353.
  {src:pbo:Addons/ui_f.pbo:78353}
- The location `drawStyle` enum holds `name`, `icon`, `area` and `mount`.
  {src:cfg:CfgLocationTypes.drawStyle}
- AEE collapses the picker to one entry. Every AEE concrete variant is scope
  0, so the picker hides it. The one visible class is `AEE_Variation`, which
  is scope 2. A CBA keybind opens a selector that changes the affiliation,
  dimension, function, echelon and palette at run time.
  {src:script:addons/symbology/config_variations.hpp}
- AEE layers the echelon. Each `AEE_Ech_*` texture holds the ticks in the top
  band of a 64 by 128 canvas. A marker at the same position shows the ticks
  above the frame. {src:script:addons/symbology/config_modifiers.hpp}

## What does not work

- A new marker-class group does not nest. The picker reads `CfgMarkerClasses`
  as one flat list. AEE carries the hierarchy in the class name and the
  `displayName`. {src:adr:ADR-028}
- The engine does not keep the marker aspect. It stretches the `texture` into
  the marker box. This is the Bohemia feedback T170754.
  {src:pbo:Addons/ui_f.pbo:84992}
- The engine routes an object to its icon. No config field sets that route. A
  re-texture reaches only the objects the engine already maps. This is the
  Bohemia ticket T157884. {src:script:addons/cartography/config_mapicons.hpp}
- A `drawStyle` value outside the enum fails. The engine logs `Wrong location
  draw style` and draws no icon. {src:cfg:CfgLocationTypes.drawStyle}

## Limitations

- The marker texture stretches to the box. A square box squashes a 2:1
  texture, so the echelon ticks land inside the frame and not above it.
  {src:adr:ADR-028}
- `drawStyle` is a fixed engine enum. A mod sets the texture, colour, size,
  font, shadow and importance only.
  {src:script:addons/cartography/config_locationtypes.hpp}
- The object-to-icon routing is engine-internal. A custom object map icon
  needs engine support. {src:adr:ADR-026}

## Breaks visually

- A marker stretched to its box shows a distorted symbol. A square icon loses
  its aspect. {src:script:addons/symbology/functions/symbology/fnc_symbologyMarkersApply.sqf}
- A colour that matches the background hides the symbol.
  {src:cfg:CfgMarkerColors.color[]}
- An echelon box of the wrong size puts the ticks inside the frame. The
  kernel returns a 1:2 box from the frame half-width.
  {src:script:addons/symbology/functions/symbology/fnc_symbologyEchelonSize.sqf}
